author: S.G.Gmelin, 1774
habitat: 서해·남해 섬의 마을과 밭, 바위가 드러난 곳

months.note: 국내에서 기록된 달로, 4월 초부터 5월 초까지 서해·남해 섬에서 주로 기록된다.

summary: 국내에서는 보기 드문 미조이다. 날개 길이는 8.6cm, 꼬리 길이는 6.5cm 정도이고, 습성은 딱새와 비슷하다고 한다. 한국, 몽골 남부, 중국 북부, 티베트, 인도, 미얀마 등지에 분포한다.

points.en: rufous-brown belly, rump and tail coverts

sexes.male: 머리·목·등·가슴이 검고 이마와 눈 둘레는 회색이며, 배·허리·꼬리덮깃은 붉은빛 갈색이다.

young: 어린새는 암컷과 비슷한 회갈색이지만 더 어둡고, 몸깃 끝에 희미한 어두운 무늬가 있다. 첫해 수컷은 대개 암컷과 거의 같아 가려 보기 어려우며, 국내에도 이런 첫 여름 수컷이 자주 찾아온다.

art.subject: Black Redstart (Phoenicurus ochruros), adult male of the eastern race rufiventris, as seen in Korea in early spring: crown, nape, mantle and scapulars dark slate-grey (with faint paler grey fringes in fresh plumage); forehead, lores, face, throat and upper breast black; wings dark grey-brown with narrow paler fringes and no white patch; from the mid-breast down the underparts, including belly, flanks and undertail coverts, deep orange-rufous; rump, uppertail coverts and outer tail feathers bright orange-rufous, central tail feathers dark brown. Bill thin and black; dark eye; legs black.
art.scene: rocky open ground with low stone walls and bare shrubs on a Korean island in early spring; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched: dark slate-grey crown, nape and back, black forehead, face, throat and upper breast, plain dark wings without a white patch, orange-rufous lower breast, belly, rump, tail coverts and outer tail feathers

adult female, side view perched: dull grey-brown head and body, faint pale eye-ring, orange-buff wash on the lower belly and undertail coverts, rufous rump and tail sides, plain wings without a white patch
art.build: Small, slim chat, about the size of a Daurian Redstart or a sparrow. Upright stance on rocks, walls and low perches, constantly shivering the tail and bobbing. Round head; bill short, thin, straight and black. Legs fairly long and slender, black. Wings plain, without a white patch. Tail medium-long, square-ended, rufous at the sides with a dark centre, quivered almost continuously.
avoid: Do not add a white wing patch or a silvery-white crown; those mark the common Daurian Redstart (Phoenicurus auroreus).
Do not carry the black down onto the belly; it ends on the upper breast and everything below is orange-rufous.
Do not paint a grey forehead or grey face; the forehead and face are black, only the crown, nape and back are dark slate-grey.
Do not give it a white forehead (Common Redstart, Phoenicurus phoenicurus).
